parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the kubeconfig file for private access.

*   `true`: returns the kubeconfig file for private access.
*   `false`: returns the kubeconfig file for public access.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the ASM instance for which you want to revoke its kubeconfig file.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh revoke-kubeconfig --service-mesh-id cf08a11940e8c46c48bc791fcdb30000 --private-ip-address false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh RevokeKubeconfig --region cn-hangzhou --PrivateIpAddress false --ServiceMeshId cf08a11940e8c46c48bc791fcdb30000
